params.caption: 🖥️ "AMDLSS5" mod brings Nvidia's neural rendering to AMD GPUs A new community mod called AMDLSS5 gets Nvidia's neural rendering tech running on AMD Radeon graphics cards. Its maker claims it performs 64% better than other mods that attempt the same thing, and installation is said to be simple — though not everyone is convinced it is worth using. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 19:53 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #AMD #Nvidia #GamingNews
